name: Team Drunkard

tenures.source: Interviewed as WNA's newly crowned World Tag Team Champions on the 14 August 2006 broadcast; announced for a Winter War six-man tag alongside Nate and Chris Supre.

caption: The WNA World Tag Team Champions as of August 2006, having won the titles from the Black Label Society the prior week.

name: PsychoDin

tenures.source: Wrestled Nate and Chris Supre to a no-contest on 21 August 2006 after two masked mystery partners interfered.

caption: A villainous pairing of Sully and Dr. Zach Lazarus, feuding with Nate and Chris Supre across WNA's August 2006 broadcasts.

name: Australia's Next Top Wrestlers

tenures.source: Instructed by Boss Rohan to eliminate rival stable Team Wrist Slash at Winter War, on the 21 August 2006 broadcast.

caption: A four-man stable tasked by WNA Boss Rohan with eliminating rival stable Team Wrist Slash at the promotion's Winter War pay-per-view.

name: Team Wrist Slash

tenures.source: Named as the rival stable Boss Rohan set Australia's Next Top Wrestlers against for Winter War, on the 21 August 2006 broadcast.

caption: A rival stable to Australia's Next Top Wrestlers; only member Kayla is named in the surviving broadcasts.
